'''KU-Sprinkle''' is a KU-Roro gardener that can be found at night listening to a lecture, down at the corner of [[Tethys Hub]] area.
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Black Shores Member:''' As you can see, we've detected a small amount of [[Remnant|Remnant Energy]] in plant sample No. 3.
:'''Black Shores Member:''' We can't confirm yet if it's from external sources or absorbed from the [[Tacetite]].
:'''Black Shores Member:''' If it's the latter, it would be a significant discovery.
:'''Black Shores Member:''' Speaking of which, bioenergy has been in use in some regions for a while. Take the [[New Federation]], for instance—
:'''KU-Sprinkle:''' Ku! I know it!
:'''KU-Sprinkle:''' I used to think watering these plants every day was pointless, but then [[Aalto]] told me:
:'''KU-Sprinkle:''' "Don't underestimate your job, KU-Sprinkle! You're helping make the world a better place!"
:'''KU-Sprinkle:''' "Did you know there are terminals made of apples and servers made of potatoes? Pretty amazing, right?"
:'''KU-Sprinkle:''' "You should be proud of yourself, pal. Everything you do here is important!"
:'''Listening Black Shores Member:''' ...?
:'''Listening Black Shores Member:''' ...?
{{Dialogue End}}
